# Balloon stand: a post with three balloons on strings tied at its top; the bunch (balloons and strings,
# origin at the knot) sways in a slow cone, 3 s a loop. Rigid: one bone. Up Z.
new
fps 24
frame range 0 72
add mesh cylinder --name Post --vertices 6 --radius 0.06 --depth 1.2 --location 0 0 0.6
material new Post --base-color 0.514 0.463 0.612
add mesh cube --name Weight --size 1 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 0.4 0.4 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Post
# strings 0.05 thick (exaggerated, still thin: drawn with a small spacing)
add mesh cylinder --name S1 --vertices 4 --radius 0.03 --depth 0.9 --location -0.12 0 1.6 --rotation 0 -15 0
add mesh cylinder --name S2 --vertices 4 --radius 0.03 --depth 1.1 --location 0 0 1.75
add mesh cylinder --name S3 --vertices 4 --radius 0.03 --depth 0.9 --location 0.12 0 1.6 --rotation 0 15 0
material new String --base-color 1 0.945 0.910 --no-slot
select S1 S2 S3
material assign String
add mesh uv-sphere --name B1 --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.32 --location -0.36 0 2.25
scale 1 1 1.2
apply --scale
material new Red --base-color 1 0 0.302 --no-slot
material assign Red
add mesh uv-sphere --name B2 --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.32 --location 0 0 2.6
scale 1 1 1.2
apply --scale
material new Blue --base-color 0.161 0.678 1 --no-slot
material assign Blue
add mesh uv-sphere --name B3 --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.32 --location 0.36 0 2.25
scale 1 1 1.2
apply --scale
material new Yellow --base-color 1 0.925 0.153 --no-slot
material assign Yellow
select S1 S2 S3 B1 B2 B3
active B2
join
rename B2 Bunch
cursor set 0 0 1.2
origin set --to cursor
select all
shade flat
select Bunch
set rotation 8 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 0
set rotation 0 8 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 18
set rotation -8 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 36
set rotation 0 -8 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 54
set rotation 8 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 72
frame set 0
export balloons.glb --bake-animations
